answer: Beacon-seeded panel sortition resists sybil grading: after answers lock, each answer's graders are drawn by the fresh beacon, unknown until it lands, so no operator can seat clones to judge its own fakes. A ring cannot pre-position members like relics in a case; to force a verdict it must control a supermajority of a randomly drawn panel, which collapses exponentially as the honest fraction of the grader garden grows. A random swarm spreads thin as light through an opal, rarely landing enough clones on one panel to sway it. Precondition: the beacon is unbiasable, graders drawn after commit.
